KpiDefinition.name: Net sales
KpiDefinition.definition: The value, units and number of sales that still stand: accepted sales less their reversals (ADR-0062). A sale counts at the instant it happened, never at the instant it was reversed, and a sale reversed in full counts for nothing. The figure reconciles with the web's /reports/.
KpiDefinition.window: A sale falls in the window when its occurred_at lies in [from 00:00 UTC, to + 1 day 00:00 UTC). Reversals recorded at any time up to generated_at are subtracted from it.

measures.definition: Sum of net_amount over the lines in the window.
Sum of net_quantity over the lines in the window.
Distinct sales with at least one line left after reversals.

KpiDefinition.name: Spend per customer
KpiDefinition.definition: What customers net-pay, counted per customer who bought: the net amount, the customers who bought and the average spend per customer. A customer who bought twice counts once as active.
KpiDefinition.window: A sale falls in the window when its occurred_at lies in [from 00:00 UTC, to + 1 day 00:00 UTC). Reversals recorded at any time up to generated_at are subtracted from it.

measures.definition: Sum of net_amount over the lines in the window.
Distinct customers with at least one line in the window. A customer who bought in two stores is active once in each store and once in the total.
net_amount divided by active_customers, to two places. Absent when active_customers is 0.

KpiDefinition.name: Cohort retention
KpiDefinition.definition: A cohort is the customers whose first net purchase ever falls in a bucket. Retention is the share of the cohort with at least one net purchase in the next bucket. By hand: three customers first buy in March and two of them buy again in April; the March cohort is 3, retained is 2 and the rate is 0.6667. Store and channel are those of the first purchase; the retained purchase may be anywhere. Period is always a dimension of a retention row.
KpiDefinition.window: from and to select cohorts by the bucket of the first purchase. The next bucket is read in full; when it has not ended at generated_at, retained_customers and retention_rate are absent for that cohort.

measures.definition: Customers whose first net purchase falls in the bucket.
Cohort customers with at least one net purchase in the next bucket.
retained_customers divided by cohort_customers, to four places.

KpiDefinition.name: Segment migrations
KpiDefinition.definition: A migration is a change of a customer's segment label between two consecutive assignments within one model version. A change across two model versions is methodological, not behaviour (ADR-0064), so it is counted apart and never in customers_migrated. A row never mixes versions. A change has no store or channel, so only segment and period group it: segment means the pair of the label left and the label entered.
KpiDefinition.window: A change falls in the window when the instant it was recorded lies in [from 00:00 UTC, to + 1 day 00:00 UTC).

measures.definition: Distinct customers with at least one change of label inside one model version.
Changes of label inside one model version.
Changes whose previous and new assignments belong to different model versions.

KpiDefinition.name: Conversion after exposure
KpiDefinition.definition: Of the customers exposed in a bucket, the share who bought within 7 days. A customer is exposed at the first recorded recommendation impression or campaign exposure in the bucket, and converts with at least one net purchase, in any store, within 7 days after that instant. It is observational and never an effect: the effect of a campaign is campaign-performance. Store and channel are those of the exposure.
KpiDefinition.window: Exposures in [from 00:00 UTC, to + 1 day 00:00 UTC). A bucket whose last exposure is under 7 days before generated_at reports converted_customers and conversion_rate absent.

measures.definition: Distinct customers with an exposure in the bucket.
Exposed customers with a net purchase within 7 days after their first exposure in the bucket.
converted_customers divided by exposed_customers, to four places.

KpiDefinition.name: Recommendation performance
KpiDefinition.definition: Impressions, clicks and purchases of recommendations. Each is counted from its own origin and none is derived from another, so a purchase is never inferred from a click.
KpiDefinition.window: An impression or click falls in the window when its occurred_at lies in [from 00:00 UTC, to + 1 day 00:00 UTC); a purchase when the sale's occurred_at does.

measures.definition: Recommendation impressions that are not voided.
RECO_CLICK events that are not voided.
Net sale lines recorded as bought through a recommendation, after reversals.

KpiDefinition.name: Campaign performance
KpiDefinition.definition: For each campaign with a measured experiment: the sales attributed to it, labelled ATTRIBUTED, and the incremental effect against its control, labelled INCREMENTAL, with its 95% interval. Attributed sales are not an effect. A campaign without a control has attributed sales and no effect. A row is a campaign, so no dimension groups it.
KpiDefinition.window: A campaign is reported when its experiment's measurement window overlaps [from, to]; the row's period is that window.

measures.definition: Net amount of sales attributed once to the campaign through its assignments.
Customers assigned to a treatment arm.
Customers assigned to the control arm.
Mean net spend per assigned treated customer less that of control, with a 95% interval in lower and upper. Absent without a control.
